name: India Glycols Ltd
title: India Glycols Ltd - 500201 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Mixed quarter: group EBITDA margin up to 15.5% on Bio-Fuels and Chemicals, but Chemicals sales fell 10.4% and Q4 had a catalyst shutdown; no capacity-discipline or pricing-cycle signal beyond management commentary.

capex.quote: there are two distilleries largely, which are the main capital expenditure

triggers.label: Grain prices down to INR21-22/kg
triggers.quote: in the last quarter of last year, they were running close to between INR21 and INR22

triggers.label: Chemicals to more than double performance chemicals
triggers.quote: we are hoping for in excess of doubling this business this year

triggers.label: Middle East oilfield chemical business on hold
triggers.quote: that business is largely on hold

guidance.value: in excess of doubling this year (hoped, not projected)
guidance.quote: we are hoping for in excess of doubling this business this year

guidance.value: about INR25 crore per quarter range
guidance.quote: our interest cost will be remaining in about INR25 crores range

guidance.value: Chemicals business totally debt-free by FY28-29
guidance.quote: in '28-'29, I'm hopeful that the Chemical business will be totally debt-free

red_flags.label: Adjusted EBITDA margin includes JV other income
red_flags.quote: if you add other income, actually our EBITDA margin is close to 20.8%

red_flags.label: Silver sale not booked as profit
red_flags.quote: there is no profit on the silver. So that's why that has not been shown in the books only

evasions.quote: we may not see the significant improvement in this financial year
I will give you the debt profile of all these three units, which is in process and I will share with you

evasions.topic: IMFL margin and Potable Spirit EBIT question
evasions.quote: I don't think that this would be a very greater percentage in this
